items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al Hibbler was with Duke at that time.

ctx.x: Al Hibbler was with Duke at that time. So when I scatted, then that’s when the musicians really accepted me as one of them, because a lot of times I scatted better then they played.
I believe that. Who were some of the musicians that you went to see while you were there? Who did you admire?
